notes.title: 🐾 My Fair Cat: Snow Has Arrived! 🎉
notes.notes:
Meow there, hoomans! 🐱
It’s me, Snow—the adorable, fluffy star of My Fair Cat: Snow (yes, I do deserve all the attention). I’ve got exciting news: the game is officially out on Steam! 🎉

Here’s the deal: You save me (thank you, hero 🐾), and in return, I turn your life upside-down in the best possible way. You’ll take care of me, make me purr, and—oh, did I mention that guy Nathan? Yeah, you’ll meet him too. He’s got a lot going on, but I think you’ll like him.

Get ready for cozy moments, feel-good vibes, and a story that will leave you smiling. Whether you’re bonding with me (your new favorite cat) or navigating life’s twists and turns, it’s going to be a pawsome journey.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2908810/My_Fair_Cat_Snow/

Thanks for rescuing me and being part of this adventure. Let’s make memories together!

Purrs and whisker kisses,
Snow 💖

notes.title: Fall in Love Tomorrow! My Fair Cat: Snow Launches on Steam!
notes.notes:
🌟 Your Next Feel-Good Adventure Awaits. Starting tomorrow, December 26th, step into the world of My Fair Cat: Snow—a story designed to make you smile, lift your spirits, and remind you of the happiness in the small things.

Begin your journey as a high school transfer student, feeling out of place in a new environment. But everything changes when you rescue a stray cat—a simple, kind-hearted moment that sparks something extraordinary.

Suddenly, your life fills with joy, challenges, and new connections, including an unexpected bond with Nathan, your classmate whose love for cats reveals a deeper, softer side of him.

This isn’t just a story about cats—it’s a story about caring, kindness, and the love that grows when you least expect it.

Why You'll Love It:
🐾 A Furry Companion to Steal Your Heart
Every story starts somewhere, and this one begins with a small, furry friend who brings you happiness and new adventures. Your bond with your cat is at the heart of everything.

❤️ Romance That Feels Real and Sweet
Nathan’s charm will catch you off guard, but it’s his depth and connection to your shared love of cats that will truly win your heart. Laugh, blush, and discover a romance full of quiet, heartfelt moments.

🌈 The Beauty in Everyday Life
From school friendships to caring for your pet, experience a slice-of-life story filled with joy and the comforting rhythm of daily routines—made all the better by your cat’s presence.

🎨 A Wholesome, Warm Art Style
The visuals are cozy and inviting, perfectly capturing the charm of cats and the little moments that make life brighter.

If you’ve ever felt the joy of caring for a pet or dreamed of a story where love and kindness can make a difference, My Fair Cat: Snow is made for you. It’s a game about making someone’s day—whether that someone is covered in fur or not.

🎉 Launching Tomorrow!
Add My Fair Cat: Snow to your Steam wishlist now, and be among the first to experience this heartwarming adventure when it launches tomorrow. Don’t miss your chance to make a little happiness for yourself and your furry friend. ❤️
